_: Engine defaults. Every value here encodes a finding from MODEL_DEV_LOG.md — the finding number is cited so you can read why before changing it. Channel identity belongs in a profile that extends this one, not here.

captions._: word-pop (heavy sans, thick stroke, no pill) outperformed the pill and broadcast presets across all three reference teardowns. 1-2 words per card; cards break on sentence end, long pause, and speaker change (F5).

pacing._: handoffGap short so narration answers the clip rather than following a beat later. maxPauseSeconds trims dead air via silence detection, not word gaps (F16). brollShot >= arollShot: b-roll under narration wants fewer, longer shots.

camera._: Only focusY varies between framings. focusX is overridden per-job by source.subjectFocusX, and scale follows one continuous curve per passage — a per-shot punch-in reads as pumping (F11).

audio._: -13 sits between broadcast (-21) and the most aggressive creator reference (-9.2). YouTube normalises to about -14 on playback, so hotter buys perceived density rather than volume; past -11 it just sounds crushed.

tts._: NEVER mp3 — 128kbps puts audible static under voiced speech (F12). Generation is stochastic, so listen to the -qc+10dB.m4a of the ACTUAL narration, not a fresh test sentence (F13).

overlays._: No end card by default: a subscribe prompt at the tail costs the loop, and rewatch feeds the algorithm harder than the subscribes it converts (F17).
